variants.label: Der begeisterte Experimentator
variants.direction: Variant 1: a relatively narrow, lively face with a slightly prominent nose, one eyebrow raised and a broad delighted toothy grin. Hair shoots in irregular starburst spikes, with individual dark-gray locks and obvious white tips, not a uniform white head. He leans very slightly forward as if sharing an exciting discovery. One palm supports the orb near the center of his chest; the other relaxed hand curves loosely above it. Simple charcoal scholar's coat with restrained plum trim. Eye-level view, near frontal, face is the main focal point.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone waist-up character portrait for Aleria, vertical 2:3, a complete single illustration, not a collage.
Reference image 1 is ONLY a reference for the established clean anime portrait rendering and soft shop-interior depth. Do not copy that man's face, age, haircut, armor, symbols, sword, or military clothing.
Scene: the interior of a modest medieval alchemist and arcanist's shop in Gwynthor, with a restrained wooden shelf, a few stoppered potion bottles, drying herbs and an old book, softly simplified behind the character. The character and both hands dominate the image. Uncluttered composition.
Subject: HERLUIN LOTHAIRE, a human man from Brevanor, an eccentric would-be grand magician and genuine herbalist. He is about 163 years old but physically looks approximately 33: a young adult's skin and face, no elderly wrinkles. He studied at the mage guild in the Blood City about 120 years ago and was expelled for unspecified experiments; do not invent the experiments or show them.
His hair is very wild, sharply spiked and sticks out in irregular directions, like a young eccentric scientist after an electric shock. Hair is DARK GRAY at the roots and through most of its length, becoming pale gray and WHITE specifically toward the tips: a single continuous gray-to-white gradient, no other hair colors. NO wizard hat. His beard is ONLY ONE SMALL neat goatee tuft on the chin: NO mustache, no sideburn beard, no jaw beard.
One natural eye is a shimmering SILVERY iris. The other eye is entirely missing and is replaced by a small faceted AMETHYST set inside the eye socket as a prosthetic: a violet gemstone rather than a normal eye, a monocle, eyepatch, or goggles. Fine visible VIOLET VEINS branch from around this amethyst socket under the skin, trail across that side of his temple and cheek and continue visibly down the same side of his exposed neck toward the nape. Subtle supernatural veins, not tattoos, not open wounds, no gore. Rounded HUMAN ears, no elven ears.
Expression: a very enthusiastic delighted grin, expressive eyebrows, unmistakably eccentric, eager to demonstrate his latest discovery. Characterful and slightly ridiculous self-confidence, not a threatening villain or a grim dark sorcerer.
Action: he holds ONE palm-sized translucent PURPLE magical crystal SPHERE in one open hand at chest height; the other hand hovers over it and actively shapes a modest violet magical shimmer. Both hands completely in frame, clearly separated, relaxed believable anatomy. The ball has luminous purple depth and soft swirls but NO recognizable vision, face, landscape, creature, eye, or scene inside it. Keep the spell modest enough to preserve facial and hand readability.
Clothing: practical worn medieval scholar-alchemist robes in muted charcoal and plum over a pale linen shirt, collar open enough to see the veins along the neck; useful sleeves rather than armor. No guild insignia, since he was expelled.
Lighting: warm soft shop light with a restrained violet reflection from the orb, natural skin color, clear silver real eye and distinct faceted gemstone eye.
Constraints: exactly one adult man, upper-body focus, face and spectacular hair fully visible with breathing room above hair; both hands and the entire orb visible. No writing, labels, portrait frame, title, watermark, extra people, modern apparatus, goggles, wizard hat, full beard, mustache, pointed ears, blue or brown natural eyes, or old-man face.

Variant 1: a relatively narrow, lively face with a slightly prominent nose, one eyebrow raised and a broad delighted toothy grin. Hair shoots in irregular starburst spikes, with individual dark-gray locks and obvious white tips, not a uniform white head. He leans very slightly forward as if sharing an exciting discovery. One palm supports the orb near the center of his chest; the other relaxed hand curves loosely above it. Simple charcoal scholar's coat with restrained plum trim. Eye-level view, near frontal, face is the main focal point.

variants.label: Der theatralische Arkanist
variants.direction: Variant 2: a more angular cheek and defined chin with a tiny single chin goatee, an extravagant joyful showman's grin and his chin lifted a little. His extremely unruly hair fans upward and sideways in larger swept-back jagged clumps, dark gray transitioning only at the tips to white. A slight three-quarter upper-body stance, shoulders back as he proudly displays the purple orb in an open palm; the other hand makes an airy gentle spellcasting gesture just above the orb. Muted plum outer robe over a charcoal vest and pale open-neck linen. Both the silver living eye and amethyst prosthetic must be plainly visible, and the branching violet veins remain visible all the way down the exposed side of his neck.

variants.label: Der verschmitzte Kräutermagier
variants.direction: Variant 3: a somewhat softer young-adult face with lively cheekbones and an irrepressible crooked enthusiastic grin. A spectacular disordered halo of sharply separated charcoal-gray hair spikes with white tips, some rising almost vertically and some sticking sideways; no round curls and no slick hairstyle. His head tilts slightly, eyes meeting the viewer as if to say that this experiment is absolutely going to work. He stands at a gentle angle, holding the purple sphere securely on one open hand while the other hand floats above and beside it with separated relaxed fingers guiding a small violet shimmer. Practical dark-gray alchemist's robe, open plum collar and pale linen, sleeves comfortably turned back. A few softly suggested medicinal herb bundles and glass bottles make the shop legible without competing with him.
